about.en: StablecoinX Inc. is a US stablecoin infrastructure company whose Class A common stock trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker USDE, following its June 2026 merger with TLGY Acquisition Corp. It operates infrastructure services, infrastructure software and distribution services built around the Ethena ecosystem, and holds a large ENA treasury. In tokenized and derivative markets, USDE is the reference equity for products tracking StablecoinX shares; it is a company share and not Ethena's USDe stablecoin.
